summary: Authorize dispatch to rebase PR #1543 (RFC-0054 sign-off, branch docs/rfc-0054-sign-off) onto main and lease-push it

options.description: Dispatch runs the rebase-resolver on #1543 with the stated conflict rule and lease-pushes docs/rfc-0054-sign-off
Leave #1543 for the operator to rebase himself
Hold #1543 until AISDLC-878 teaches rebase-in-place the real head branch

body: PR #1543 carries the RFC-0054 Signed Off status, its normative Configuration section and the implementation tasks AISDLC-878..885. It is DIRTY against main since #1574 (AISDLC-902) changed the RFC-0054 status line and the README registry row. The reconciler's rebase-in-place derives ai-sdlc/file-rfc-0054 and never finds the real head branch, and dispatch's rebase grant covers task branches only, so the rebase needs a record on main. Conflict rule: the branch wins on spec/rfcs/RFC-0054-*.md (status Signed Off, Configuration section); spec/rfcs/README.md keeps main's registry except the RFC-0054 row, which reads Signed Off; every backlog/tasks file from both sides is kept; the sign-off text is not changed. A semantic conflict stops the run and is reported. Five-step: requirement questioned (landing #1543 unblocks the docs-lane tasks 878-885, so yes); nothing to delete; simplified to one mechanical rebase; accelerated by not waiting for the operator; automation gap recorded for AISDLC-878. Class (a): reversible (the branch is lease-pushed, the old head stays in reflog), docs only, no trust-chain or governance control touched.
